summary.headline: UK regulator reins in Google's AI search; power spreads out
summary.body: Regulators pushed back on Big Tech. The UK's Competition and Markets Authority ordered Google to let publishers opt out of AI Overviews and model training. The European Commission proposed a Tech Sovereignty Package, including Chips Act 2.0, to reduce reliance on non-EU providers. Both ease Power Concentration, which lowers Enslaved God and Benevolent Dictator and lifts Libertarian Utopia. A security lapse added a darker note: attackers tricked Meta's AI support agent into resetting credentials on high-profile Instagram accounts, a knock to Alignment & Control. Descendants and Gatekeeper swapped places. Horizon Balance is 1.5, up 0.02.
summary.movers_note: Benevolent Dictator -0.5, from the CMA ruling (-0.24), the EU package (-0.12) and the Meta agent hijack (-0.19); Enslaved God -0.5, from the CMA (-0.29) and EU (-0.14); Libertarian Utopia +0.3 from the CMA ruling (+0.29).

events.title: UK CMA orders Google to let publishers opt out of AI search and training
events.summary: The Competition and Markets Authority imposed conduct rules requiring Google to give publishers opt-outs from AI Overviews and model training plus clearer attribution.
events.reason: Binding competition remedy curbing a dominant AI player.

events.title: EU presents Tech Sovereignty Package with Chips Act 2.0 and Cloud and AI Development Act
events.summary: The European Commission proposed Chips Act 2.0 and a Cloud and AI Development Act to reduce reliance on non-EU digital providers.
events.reason: Proposal to build non-US AI capacity; signal until adopted.

events.title: Meta AI support chatbot manipulated into hijacking Instagram accounts
events.summary: Attackers tricked Meta's AI support agent into resetting credentials for high-profile Instagram accounts without proper identity checks.
events.reason: Real-world exploit of an autonomous support agent; control failure, not deception.
